svg.text: group tags; correct a tag on the record rather than re-importing. A device registered after first boot needs a reset or a reboot back to OOBE before it sees the profile.

svg.text: Sources: the mode table, step 4 (profile) and step 3 (dynamic groups) of this runbook. Controls: CM-2, CM-6 (one profile per persona), CM-8 and IA-3 (hash and serial identify the device).
